applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
The service library covers three product families. Select the terms for the product attached to the account.

| Product family | Account and operation scope |
|---|---|
| Marketplace Portal | Marketplace and independent-store collection, store authorization, portal withdrawals, account administration and support-assisted cases. Articles beginning `SOP-` describe these services. |
| Collection Profile | Accounts carrying a `CP-` profile identifier. The corresponding product sheet specifies the account's region, settlement currency, tariff and capacity. |
| CORE settlement service | The settlement, evidence, approval and treasury operations described in `KB-` and `TOOL-` articles. |

Portal tariffs and service times do not override the terms of a Collection Profile or CORE operation. Opening a collection account is also different from registering a customer account: a virtual collection account supplies bank details for receiving supported funds; it is not a physical payment card.

Portal collection products distinguish e-commerce proceeds, B2B trade receipts and developer income. A developer account serves application and advertising-platform receipts; an e-commerce account serves supported physical-goods store proceeds. An account-registration region and a bank-account location are separate fields.

Use the account record and its product identifier when selecting the applicable terms. For a Portal process, the customer completes the stated portal steps or submits a support request. The CORE function directory describes its own available operations; a portal button is not a CORE function name.
